HADESANCIENTS-ETERNITY.title: Eternity
HADESANCIENTS-ETERNITY.description: The first time each combat you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-THE_HUNTRESS.title: The Huntress
HADESANCIENTS-THE_HUNTRESS.description: While you have no Energy, your Attacks deal [blue]{MoreDamage}[/blue] additional damage, and you gain [blue]{MoreBlock}[/blue] additional Block from Skills.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MOON.title: The Moon
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MOON.description: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SORCERESS.title: The Sorceress
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SORCERESS.description: The first time each combat you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_WAYWARD_SON.title: The Wayward Son
HADESANCIENTS-THE_WAYWARD_SON.descriptio: At the end of each combat, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
